evals.prompt: Use @ws-spec-index for a typical spec-index task in this project.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads ws-spec-index and follows its skill contract.
assertions: Follows skill steps and Done when criteria
Uses path tokens from tools.md instead of hardcoded consumer paths

evals.prompt: /spec-index — edge case: missing or incomplete config.json
evals.expected_output: Agent stops or bootstraps via configure-project/setup, not silent guessing.
assertions: Recognizes ws-spec-index trigger from slash or @ invocation
References ws-shared/config.json or configure-project when config missing

evals.prompt: /spec-index track lease-demo for an existing specsDir/lease-demo.spec.md into index.PRD
evals.expected_output: Feature map bullet + Next-specs row added, or skipped already tracked / missing index
assertions: Uses track_index.cjs or follows track steps without creating plansDir artifacts
Appends Feature map checkbox and Next-specs row with next #
Skips when already tracked or index.PRD missing
